description:
A domain-neutral record of an asserted or unknown asset/component state.

Grounded in one or more Observations, produced by a Model, and optionally
interpreted by a DomainPolicy. This is the open, minimal shape of the
concept described in the Athena architecture glossary — it intentionally
omits proprietary calibration, topology, and measurement-provenance
fields that remain part of the closed implementation.

contract_version.description: Wire version of this contract. Consumers must reject unknown major versions rather than guess field meaning.

observation_ids.description: Observations this finding is grounded in.
observation_ids.title: Observation Ids

model_id.description: Model artifact that produced this finding.
model_id.title: Model Id

is_unknown_state.description: True when the model could not confidently classify the state, rather than asserting a specific known label.
is_unknown_state.title: Is Unknown State

title: AssetStateFinding
